name: Routing Policy v1
summary: Initial production observation period after completing FAST/BALANCED routing benchmarks and implementing deterministic interactive routing.
goal: Observe approximately 100 real OpenClaw requests before changing the routing policy.
context: FAST is the default interactive tier.
BALANCED is used selectively for architecture, security, migrations, complex tradeoffs, financial/data-integrity risk, and explicit deep/thorough analysis.
DEEP/minimax-m3 is reserved for explicit extended or asynchronous work.
benchmark_findings: FAST final benchmark average latency: approximately 14.9 seconds.
BALANCED final benchmark average latency: approximately 50.5 seconds.
BALANCED benchmark cost/request was approximately 26x FAST.
Both tiers succeeded on 15/15 final benchmark prompts.
notes: Historical telemetry before this snapshot contains benchmark/test traffic and should not be treated as real post-policy usage.
